title: Resend
description: The next-generation transactional email platform for developers, built around React Email components, first-class DX, and high deliverability.
features: Native React Email component support for code-first HTML templates
DKIM, SPF, and DMARC 1-click domain verification
Real-time event webhooks for delivered, bounced, and clicked emails
Comprehensive REST API and first-party SDKs for Node, Python, Ruby, Go
Broadcast marketing email engine alongside transactional pipelines
pros: Cleanest developer dashboard and modern API design in the email industry
Eliminates painful table-based HTML email slicing
cons: Strict automated spam filtering can flag unverified sender domains
Paid tiers scale quickly with high-volume bulk marketing sends
targetAudience: Modern full-stack developers and SaaS founders sending transactional & onboarding emails.
